teacherNote: Marked against: Part (i): Ray diagram for object at infinity with correct ray paths / extensions to focus / and directional arrows (1); Part (i): Stating the position / nature / and relative size of the image (0.5); Part (ii): Ray diagram for object between infinity and pole with correct ray paths / image between P and F / and directional arrows (1); Part (ii): Stating the position / nature / and relative size of the image (0.5). Neat diagrams and accurate statements of image characteristics. However, always draw arrows on light rays to indicate their direction of travel, as ray diagrams without directional arrows lose marks in CBSE examinations.
